title: Get 2fauth settings
description: Get 2fauth settings. Secrets are never returned.

host.description: Host name for the application, like '2fauth.domain.org'

lets_encrypt.title: Let's Encrypt certificate
lets_encrypt.description: Request a valid Let's Encrypt certificate.

http2https.title: HTTP to HTTPS redirection
http2https.description: Redirect all the HTTP requests to HTTPS

app_name.title: Application name
app_name.description: 2FAuth APP_NAME, shown in the web app, the e-mails and the WebAuthn prompts. Default '2FAuth'. Changing it logs every user out (the session cookie name derives from it).

mail_from_address.title: Sender address
mail_from_address.description: 2FAuth MAIL_FROM_ADDRESS. Empty: the smarthost user name when it is an e-mail address, else noreply@<host>. Mail goes through the NS8 smarthost.

enable_sso.title: Enable SSO
enable_sso.description: 2FAuth admin setting enableSso (stored in the 2FAuth database). Default true.

use_sso_only.title: SSO only
use_sso_only.description: 2FAuth admin setting useSsoOnly: users log in with OpenID or GitHub only. Requires a configured provider. Default false.

disable_registration.title: Disable registration
disable_registration.description: 2FAuth admin setting disableRegistration: no new account can be created with the registration form. Register the first (admin) account before disabling it. Default false.

keep_sso_registration_enabled.title: Keep SSO registration
keep_sso_registration_enabled.description: 2FAuth admin setting keepSsoRegistrationEnabled: a user who logs in with SSO for the first time gets an account even when registration is disabled. Default false.

openid_client_id.title: OpenID client ID
openid_client_id.description: 2FAuth OPENID_CLIENT_ID. Empty disables the OpenID provider and removes its saved secret. Redirect URI to register: https://<host>/socialite/callback/openid

openid_http_verify_ssl_peer.title: Verify the OpenID provider certificate
openid_http_verify_ssl_peer.description: 2FAuth OPENID_HTTP_VERIFY_SSL_PEER. Default true. Disable only for a provider with a self-signed certificate.

github_client_id.title: GitHub client ID
github_client_id.description: 2FAuth GITHUB_CLIENT_ID. Empty disables GitHub login and removes its saved secret. Authorization callback URL to register: https://<host>/socialite/callback/github

mail_from_name.title: Sender name
mail_from_name.description: CLI only. 2FAuth MAIL_FROM_NAME. Empty: the application name.

app_timezone.title: Timezone
app_timezone.description: CLI only. 2FAuth APP_TIMEZONE, used to record dates in the database, like 'Europe/Rome'. Default 'UTC'. Existing records are not converted. Users choose their display timezone in their own settings.

log_channel.title: Log channel
log_channel.description: CLI only. 2FAuth LOG_CHANNEL: 'daily' (7 rotated files in the 2fauth-app volume, default), 'single', 'stderr' (the container log, in the journal) or 'errorlog'.

session_lifetime.title: Session lifetime
session_lifetime.description: CLI only. 2FAuth SESSION_LIFETIME, in minutes. Default 120.

login_throttle.title: Login throttle
login_throttle.description: CLI only. 2FAuth LOGIN_THROTTLE: failed logins allowed per minute before a lockout. Default 5.

throttle_api.title: API throttle
throttle_api.description: CLI only. 2FAuth THROTTLE_API: API calls per minute from one IP; null disables the limit. Default 60.

throttle_api_during_import.title: API throttle during import
throttle_api_during_import.description: CLI only. 2FAuth THROTTLE_API_DURING_IMPORT: API calls per minute made by the Import feature; null disables the limit. Default 1000.

authentication_log_retention.title: Authentication log retention
authentication_log_retention.description: CLI only. 2FAuth AUTHENTICATION_LOG_RETENTION, in days. Default 365.

otp_log_retention.title: OTP log retention
otp_log_retention.description: CLI only. 2FAuth OTP_LOG_RETENTION, in days. Default 365.

webauthn_name.title: WebAuthn name
webauthn_name.description: CLI only. 2FAuth WEBAUTHN_NAME, the relying party name shown by security keys. Empty: the application name.

block_otpauth_imagelink_fetching.title: Block otpauth image links
block_otpauth_imagelink_fetching.description: CLI only. 2FAuth BLOCK_OPTAUTH_IMAGELINK_FETCHING: never fetch the images linked in imported QR codes (SSRF defense). Default true.

php_memory_limit_temp_override.title: QR code memory limit
php_memory_limit_temp_override.description: CLI only. 2FAuth PHP_MEMORY_LIMIT_TEMP_OVERRIDE, in MB, applied while decoding uploaded QR codes. Default 512.

allow_pat_while_sso_only.title: Allow personal access tokens with SSO only
allow_pat_while_sso_only.description: CLI only. 2FAuth admin setting allowPatWhileSsoOnly (stored in the 2FAuth database). Default false.

user_preferences.title: User preferences
user_preferences.description: CLI only. Default and locked user preferences (2FAuth USERPREF_DEFAULT__<NAME> and USERPREF_LOCKED__<NAME>). Keys are the upper-case preference names, like THEME or LANG. The object replaces the saved one; {} removes them all. See https://docs.2fauth.app/getting-started/config/user-preferences/

openid_client_secret_set.title: OpenID client secret saved
openid_client_secret_set.description: True when a value is saved in state/passwords.env. The value itself is never returned.

github_client_secret_set.title: GitHub client secret saved
github_client_secret_set.description: True when a value is saved in state/passwords.env. The value itself is never returned.

proxy_for_outgoing_requests_set.title: Outgoing proxy saved
proxy_for_outgoing_requests_set.description: True when a value is saved in state/passwords.env. The value itself is never returned.

app_settings_source.description: 'live': the admin settings were read from the running 2FAuth; 'saved': the last values applied by the module (or the defaults).
